title_sq: Apartament - Për Shitje - Bulevardi i Ri, Tiranë
description_sq:
2+1+Post parkimi tek Bulevardi Ri
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e peste banim te rezidences "Orbital 6", pjese e ndertimit te kompanise "Gener II".
Organizohet ne nje sallon te bollshem ndenje me ambjent gatimi,dy dhoma gjumi, dy tualete, depo, korridor shperndares dhe ballkon, i orientuar totalisht ne lindje dhe me pamje nga parku dhe bulevardi ri.
Ne cmim perfshihet edhe nje post parkimi ne katin -2.
title_en: Apartment - For Sale - New Boulevard, Tirana
description_en: 2+1+Parking post at Ri Boulevard The apartment is located on the fifth residential floor of the residence "Orbital 6", part of the construction of the company "Gener II". It is organized in a spacious living room with kitchen area, two bedrooms, two bathrooms, storage room, distribution corridor and balcony, totally oriented to the east and overlooking the park and the new boulevard. The price also includes a parking space on the -2nd floor.
